estimates.assumptions: Standard garlic clove is ~3g each when chopped; 2 cloves total 6g edible portion.
Average trimmed lemongrass stalk for cooking is ~5g edible inner portion (outer layers and tops discarded); 3 stalks total 15g.
Medium red chilli ~40g each whole; 2 sliced chillies total 80g (edible after slicing, seeds included as per recipe).
1 tsp five-spice powder weighs ~2g; calorie density is a typical value for spice blends.
